name: Price & Cart Hider – Hide Prices & Add to Cart Buttons
author: WooSofts

sections.description:
Price & Cart Hider lets you transform your WooCommerce store into a flexible catalog or private shopping experience. Effortlessly hide prices and Add to Cart buttons based on your own rules — by product, category, or tag — without writing a single line of code.

Need help? Email support@woosofts.com

🔥 Key Features

  • Hide Prices Anywhere: Remove or hide product prices across your store
  • Hide Add to Cart Button: Disable purchasing while keeping your catalog visible
  • Custom Replacement Text: Display messages like “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Pricing”
  • Flexible Rule System: Apply settings to products, categories, or tags
  • Exclude Specific Products: Keep control over visibility for selected products
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built with performance and simplicity in mind
  • Theme Compatible: Works seamlessly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes

🎯 Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores – Keep retail users from seeing wholesale prices
  • Catalog-Only Websites – Display products without purchase options
  • Membership-Based Shops – Restrict pricing to logged-in members
  • B2B Marketplaces – Create business-only shopping experiences
  • Private Pricing Models – Offer exclusive prices to select users

🚀 Professional Tools

  • Smart visibility management
  • Intuitive and modern admin interface
  • Full compatibility with WooCommerce standards
  • Optimized, clean, and secure code
  • Customizable replacement messages
  • Works well with caching and optimization plugins

Third Party Services

This plugin uses:
* Material-UI (MUI) – https://mui.com/material-ui/

Additional Information

For feedback or assistance, email support@woosofts.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Price & Cart Hider”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to configure your settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the entire price-cart-hider folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to begin setup
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices for specific products only?

Yes! You can target individual products, entire categories, or product tags for full control.

Can I show a custom message instead of hiding the price?

Absolutely. Replace the hidden price with any message — for example, “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Pricing”.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, Price & Cart Hider works perfectly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes! It’s built with optimized, minimal code that ensures top performance without slowing down your site.

Where can I get support?

We offer support via email:
* Email: support@woosofts.com
